type.description: The gyroscope type. Use "custom" for a gyro YAGSL has no built-in type for; SwerveParser skips creating a gyro device for "custom" and expects the SwerveDriveConfig you pass to SwerveParser.createSwerveDrive(...)/createSwerveDriveDevices(...) to already have .withGyro(...) (and optionally .withGyroOffset(...)/.withGyroVelocity(...)) set.

id.description: CAN ID of the Gyroscope. If no CAN ID is needed, set this to 0. Ignored when type is "custom".

canbus.description: CAN bus the gyroscope is on: "" for the Systemcore CAN bus can_s0, "1" to "4" for can_s1 to can_s4, or "5" to "24" for the Motioncore CAN buses can_d0 to can_d19. CTRE devices also take a CANivore's name. Ignored when type is "custom".

channel.description: Systemcore USB port of a USB gyroscope (navx3_usb): 0 for USB0 to 3 for USB3. Defaults to 0. Ignored by other gyroscopes.

gyroAxis.description: The axis to use for the robot heading. Default is yaw.

modules.description: Swerve module JSON files under the 'modules/' directory.
